retake.retakeFee: No additional fee (covered by the permit application fee)

gdl.supervisedHoursRequired: 65 hours (10 at night, 5 in inclement weather)
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 11 p.m.-5 a.m. for junior drivers (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: no more than 1 passenger under 18 who is not immediate family; after that, up to 3 passengers under 18 (unless a parent/guardian is present)

requiredDocuments: Completed Form DL-180 (non-commercial learner's permit application); DL-180TD for applicants under 18
Proof of identity (e.g. birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Two proofs of Pennsylvania residency (for REAL ID / adults)
Completed DL-180C physical exam form (from a medical provider)
process.realIdNotes: REAL ID is optional in Pennsylvania. It requires proof of identity, proof of Social Security number, and two proofs of current PA residency. A U.S. passport can be used for federal purposes instead.
process.permitFee: $45.50 total for an initial non-commercial learner's permit and four-year Class C driver's license ($6 permit fee plus $39.50 license fee)
process.licenseFee: Included in the $45.50 initial permit-and-license fee
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Reaching 6 points triggers PennDOT action; first time requires a written point exam. Points are not an automatic suspension until repeated accumulations or a hearing.
facts.moveOverRule: Steer Clear / Move Over Law: move over one lane, or slow to a safe and reasonable speed if unable to move over, when approaching an emergency response area with flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph where posted (many segments are posted lower)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 mph in posted school zones when the warning lights are flashing or during posted hours
